description: The fields a conforming SENDER may put on each inner type (protocol.md §4, §4.2). This is the code->spec direction of decision #24: message.validate() answers 'is what I received well-formed?', and nothing asked 'is what I emitted named by the spec?'. A field absent from this list is one an implementation invented, which decision #23 forbids. It is deliberately a field allowlist and not a second schema: presence and type are already pinned by messages.json, and duplicating them here would produce a check that agrees with itself. Pinned from protocol.md by hand and gated in both directions by specsrc, so a type added to the spec without an entry here fails, and an entry here for a type the spec does not define fails too.

notes.chunk: An object {i, n}; its own members are pinned by messages.json and §6.1.
notes.payload-xor-seg: Exactly one of payload and seg is present on data (§4.1); this file lists both because both are legal fields, and which one is required is a schema question messages.json already answers.
notes.rekey-body: Absent on phase 4, which carries no BMX message (§4.2).
notes.bye-reason: Optional and open-ended: §8 defines the reasons a conforming sender uses and requires a receiver to accept any string.
